services.name: 2-Hour Sail
services.desc: Tour Details A unique way to experience Maine and discover the hidden secrets of the Saco River and Saco Bay in an intimate setting of no more than 6. Have fun and create memories that will last a lifetime! Reserve a spot for a 2 hour escape sail, relax and enjoy the beauty of the Saco River, Biddeford Pool, Camp Ellis, Wood Island Lighthouse and Old Orchard Beach. We limit this tour to 2/3 the ship's rated capacity. This provides our guests with plenty of seating and room to spread out for a truly enjoyable experience on the water. All ages are welcome! Boat Departures 2 to 4 times daily, based on time of the year. Departure times vary based on when the sunsets, see schedule for daily

services.name: Private Full Moon Charter
services.desc: Tour Details If you never have seen a full moon rise from a boat you are in for a unique experience! Come make special memories with friends or/and family! Book online today! Watch the full moon rise while taking in the breathtaking beauty of Saco Bay! These Charters are timed to watch the moon rise after the sun sets based on the below schedule. Flower Moon - May 2 - Starts 8:00pm Blue Moon - May 29 - 31 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Strawberry Moon - June 27 - 29 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Buck Moon - July 27 - 31 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Sturgeon Moon - August 26 - September 1 - Starts between 6:30 to 8:00pm Harvest Moon - September 24 - 29 - Starts between 5:00 to 6:30pm
